color.$description: Colour ROLES — what each colour paints. Skins read these, themes redefine them. Naming: `--color-<what it paints>-<role>[-<state>]`.

surface.$description: Page and in-flow surfaces: inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons, alerts.

surface-raised.$description: Panels laid over the page: card, menu, popover, tooltip, drawer, data table.

surface-sunken.$description: Recessed areas: image placeholder, tab track.

surface-inverse.$description: Inverse panel (the `dark` variants of listbox, drawer, bottom sheet, ghost-dark icon button).

surface-inverse-hover.$description: Hover fill on an inverse panel.

surface-inverse-pressed.$description: Pressed fill on an inverse panel.

surface-inverse-selected.$description: Selected fill on an inverse panel.

overlay.$description: Scrim behind a modal, drawer or bottom sheet.

fill.$description: Neutral filled control: secondary button, badge, avatar, skeleton.

fill-hover.$description: Hover of a neutral filled control.

hover.$description: Hover fill of a list item, ghost/outline button, pagination button.

pressed.$description: Pressed/active fill of a list item.

selected.$description: Selected fill of a list item or table row.

track.$description: Unfilled part of a slider or progress bar.

text-secondary.$description: Labels, hints, dates, secondary glyphs (≥4.5:1 on surface).

text-disabled.$description: Disabled text, empty-list message — below 4.5:1, never for content.

text-on-primary.$description: Text and icons on a primary fill.

text-on-destructive.$description: Text and icons on a destructive fill.

text-on-success.$description: Text and icons on a success fill.

text-destructive.$description: Error text and glyph (5.9:1 on white): field error message, error alert, destructive menu item.

text-on-inverse-strong.$description: Emphasised text on an inverse panel (hover, selected).

text-on-inverse-secondary.$description: Secondary text and glyphs on an inverse panel.

fill-on-inverse.$description: Light fill on an inverse panel (pressed ghost-dark icon button).

fill-on-inverse-hover.$description: Hover of the light fill on an inverse panel.

border-strong.$description: Boundary of a control (field, outline button) — the lightest grey at ≥3:1 on white (WCAG 1.4.11).

focus.$description: Focus outline — ≥3:1 on white and on the inverse panel.

primary.$description: Primary action fill; also checked box, active tab, slider fill.

destructive-hover.$description: Hover of the destructive fill; error message text (5.9:1).

rating-empty.$description: Empty part of a rating (display-only, see known issues).
